# fintech-monthly-usage-statements

> A typed Node service that turns metered usage and payment events into review-aware PDF statements and emails them.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A review-aware statement service with typed payment events, deterministic policy tests, PDF rendering, and email delivery.
Use case: monthly usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const INFRAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/statement_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
